newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its American counterpart on Friday on U.S. dollar buying triggered by the firming U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.492 against Thursday's T$27.489 close. Turnover was a slow US$127.5 million.

The Taiwan dollar rose to T$27.487 in morning trade due to some inflows of foreign equity funds. "But foreign funds did not show active inflows because they are likely separated for entries in several sessions," said one dealer.
